explication: Oracle AI Developer Hub is a collection of independent applications and reference implementations, not one integrated runtime. A developer selects an example and follows its own user-to-result workflow; the README describes the examples’ capabilities, but does not establish runtime links between them. The graph preserves the README’s major application branches and the sampled central modules that exist in the supplied tree. Internal calls between these separate products are omitted because the excerpts do not show them.
